name: Inside an AI Data Center: GPUs, Networks and Storage in One Hour
description: A plain-English, one-hour walk through an AI data center: what a model asks of hardware, what is inside a GPU server, how GPUs talk over NVLink, InfiniBand and Ethernet, where the data lives, and why AI racks need so much power and cooling.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Inside an AI Data Center: GPUs, Networks and Storage in One Hour

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 6 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
